tool.name: ShortestPaths
tool.description: : Shortest paths between residues in a network graph.

param.name: input_graph_path
param.label: input file
param.help: Path to input GraphML graph (nodes should carry resid).. Format: [input].

param.name: outname_output_shortest_paths_path
param.label: output name
param.help: Path to output JSON with paths and weights. Format: [output].

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: num_paths
param.label: num_paths
param.help: Maximum number of shortest simple paths to report.

param.name: restart
param.label: restart
param.help: Skip execution if output already exists.
